hook.say: True or false? Five more facts about Turkey, three seconds each. The last one rewrote the history books!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Türkiye uses a single time zone.
questions.say: Turkey uses a single time zone.
questions.fact: The whole country has been on UTC+3 all year round since 2016.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The whole country runs on 1 time, with no clock changes since 2016.

questions.q: The Bosphorus connects the Black Sea to the Aegean Sea.
questions.fact: It links the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara.
questions.sayAnswer: False! It links the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara.

questions.q: The Tigris and the Euphrates both begin in Türkiye.
questions.say: The Tigris and the Euphrates both begin in Turkey.
questions.fact: Both great rivers rise in the mountains of eastern Türkiye.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Both great rivers rise in the mountains of eastern Turkey.

questions.q: Lake Van, Türkiye's largest lake, is a freshwater lake.
questions.say: Lake Van, Turkey's largest lake, is a freshwater lake.
questions.fact: Lake Van is a salty soda lake with no outlet.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Lake Van is a salty soda lake with no outlet.

questions.q: Göbekli Tepe in Türkiye is thousands of years older than Stonehenge.
questions.say: Gobekli Tepe in Turkey is thousands of years older than Stonehenge.
questions.fact: Built around 9500 BCE, it predates Stonehenge by some 6,000 years.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Its carved stone pillars are about 6000 years older than Stonehenge.
